title: New table set: board, shutters and pieces, with the app's market boxes and a crate shown by stepping the shutter back (print and play)
problem: The owner has no board, shutters, fruit pieces, price tags, markers, chips or tokens, and no files exist for them, so the printed game cannot be played. Tracking freshness by sliding every piece each night is slow and easy to get wrong.
scope: Board in two A3 panels side by side (84 cm): on the left the Wholesale Market in the app's box style (four fruit lanes, each box with its letter, cost and where the lorry unloads), with today's event and tomorrow's lorry beside it, each next to its deck for an easy flip, and the day track (1 to 14, Market Days and game ends marked); on the right the customer rows (today: up to 5 and a guest; tomorrow: the regular and up to 4 walk-ins; the customer deck) and the crier's price rule. Favour cards, upgrades and standing orders have no space on the board: their piles sit beside it

Stall sheets with a crate band in front of the shelf band (each crate box in line with its shelf box), two shutter lines, a write-on price box at the end of each crate lane (dry-wipe, behind the shutter until the bell) and the Fruit sold row (1 to 80) along the bottom; at the bell every shutter steps back one line together, so crate and prices show and no piece is carried

6 shutters (half A3, folded to stand, both sides), 6 counters with only the cash track and a public crate-count track (0 to 10), four to an A4 sheet, 6 bid cards for standing orders (write the bid, lay it face down; the back shows the stall pattern), a token sheet (12 cash markers, 36 served-alone chips, day marker, first-player token, Shade Cloth marker, 6 +$200 chips, 6 crate-count markers); no price tags; all rectangles for a guillotine
A shopping list: 200 wooden cubes, 10 mm, 50 each of blue, green, yellow and red; 6 dry-wipe pens
Guidebook, player aid and RULES.md print-and-play part: set-up, the bell with the shutter step, what is in the box (no rule change)
Print tests from the game data (parts counted, card spaces fit 63 x 88 mm, boxes fit a 10 mm cube, each lane has its fruit's boxes, crate boxes line up with shelf boxes, day track to 14)
The print-shop package rebuilt with a print order and the shopping list; the update pack and both tracker test packs retired
exclusions: No game rule or card change; the app is unchanged
No ordering, printing or buying: the owner decides and pays

acceptance.text: npm run verify passes, with the new print tests
Every new page seen as a picture
Sizes measured from the PDFs (card spaces, boxes, crate and shelf in line, shutters, cut sizes)
The owner's small test: one stall sheet, one shutter and the market panel, a few days with coins or beads
A full table game with the printed set
